        if res>mod: return None

def smallest_odd_prime_factor(n):
    # n is integer >0
    # return smallest odd prime divisor >1, or None if n is power of 2?
    # use sympy factorint
    fac = sp.factorint(n)
    odd_primes = [p for p in fac if p%2==1]
    if not odd_primes:
        return None
    return min(odd_primes)

    return None
